name: Scrub Island Resort, Spa & Marina
insider_take: A pristine private island paradise where luxury meets untouched Caribbean beauty, just minutes from Tortola but worlds away from everything else.
whats_special: This is the British Virgin Islands' only private island resort, sitting on 230 acres of unspoiled tropical terrain. The island features three distinct beaches, each offering different experiences - from calm swimming waters to dramatic cliff-side views. The resort's deep-water marina can accommodate mega-yachts up to 160 feet, making it a premier destination for luxury sailing enthusiasts.
pro_tip: Book the helicopter transfer from Beef Island Airport for a spectacular aerial tour of the BVI archipelago - it's only 3 minutes but offers breathtaking views you'll never forget.
dont_miss: The resort's three-hole golf course designed around natural rock formations and coastal views, plus snorkeling at nearby Monkey Point where you can swim alongside sea turtles in crystal-clear waters just a short kayak ride away.
pros: Private island location with pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters
Full-service marina with water sports and yacht accommodations
Multiple dining options with fresh Caribbean cuisine
cons: Remote island location requires ferry or private boat access
Limited off-property dining and entertainment options
